pytest_results.c_full_suite: 136 passed / 7 failed / 1 skipped (baseline preserved — all 7 failures are pre-existing, not introduced by this mission)

wonder_white_10k_lidded.fired_via: plateau candidate (cliff did NOT fire — plateau wins earliest)

dry_decision.rationale: find_confirmed_drop_start tests a sustained °C/s rate with confirm_n-sample confirmation. The cliff candidate tests a single-sample magnitude (°C, not rate) plus monotonic-decline (not threshold-rate) confirmation. Semantics differ enough that forcing reuse would require two new parameters that mean something different from the existing ones on the helper. Kept the candidate inline (~50 lines including guards) — simpler than bending the shared helper.

parameter_choices.INSTANT_DROP_THRESHOLD_C: 15.0 per briefing (sensible default, physics-motivated cliff magnitude)
parameter_choices.CLIFF_MONOTONIC_CONFIRM_SAMPLES: 5 per briefing (25 s at 5 s/sample — rules out noise, fits truncated tails)
parameter_choices.CLIFF_PRE_PEAK_PLATEAU_SECONDS: 250 s — discriminator added during implementation after discovering that real unlidded CSVs (100098DE, BA3C_0946, BA3C_1759) all contain legitimate probe-pull cliffs ≥15 °C that arrive DURING ordinary cooldown and whose tests expect end at a LATER cool-to-ambient point. Empirical separation on running-peak-so-far within 2 °C: lidded fixtures (PWM 315 s, synthetic 325 s) vs. unlidded (BA3C_1759 bake-1 175 s, BA3C_0946 110 s, 100098DE 0 s, wonder white 0 s). 250 s sits 65 s inside both margins. Re-expressed in samples via median dt for sample-period invariance.
parameter_choices.CLIFF_PRE_PEAK_TOLERANCE_C: 2.0 — covers wonder-white-style small fluctuations (100.3 → 99.6 → 97.6) without loosening too far.

risks_addressed.cliff_firing_on_legitimate_fast_cool: Addressed via CLIFF_PRE_PEAK_PLATEAU_SECONDS guard. Verified on BA3C_1759 bake-1 (cliff at j=944 rejected because pre-cliff at-plateau run was only 175 s), real_100098DE_1351 (cliff at j=306 rejected, plateau run was 0 s — already past peak), real_1000BA3C_0946 (cliff at j=293 rejected, plateau run was 110 s).
risks_addressed.aggregator_ordering: No change to ordering. Candidate added as the 6th; earliest-confirmed wins. On wonder white, plateau fires at idx 338 and cliff at idx ~350 but is earliest=338 via plateau (verified).
risks_addressed.monotonic_strictness: Used weakly monotonic (≤, equality allowed) per briefing — noise 0.0 diffs don't reject real cliffs.

caveats.plateau_threshold_is_fixture_fitted: The 250 s separation was calibrated against the current 5 known fixtures. If a future lidded CSV has a shorter pre-pull plateau (≤ 250 s) the cliff won't fire; if a future unlidded CSV has a longer pre-cliff plateau (≥ 250 s) it will spuriously fire. Cross-CSV validation on more real fixtures is recommended before tightening or loosening.
caveats.scan_origin: Candidate scans from peak_idx (not peak_idx + post_peak_grace) because the synthetic fixture's cliff falls AT peak. This matches the plateau candidate's scan convention (line 548 in curve_boundary_detector.py).
